Select apps to add them to the MultiStar cover list. Clear a checkbox to remove an app. Tap Refresh after installing a new app.

For first-time setup, open Setup and use Shizuku, or grant permission with ADB. Shizuku v13+ must be running, and you must be able to open this app first.

If icons have not refreshed, switch cover widgets and back.

The app does not restrict MultiStar versions. An unrecognized configuration format is read-only.

Change the display language under Setup → Language.
